description: 1989 is when blondie said 'country girl era is OVER, I'm the pop queen now' and she was so right it hurts 💅✨ 'Blank Space', 'Style', 'Bad Blood', 'Wildest Dreams'?? this is a no-skip pop masterpiece and the Harry Styles tea is DELICIOUS. It's giving full NYC popstar rebirth and honestly the entire world stopped that year. Flawless, iconic, mother's magnum opus before she got sad again 🔥😭
